== Research Notes ==

=== Cookstown retirement and possible mill-family connection ===

A Belfast News-Letter report describes William Glasgow, Esq., of Cookstown retiring from business on 1 January 1856. Commercial friends met at the Imperial Hotel, Belfast, and presented a silver ewer and cake basket.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/390544967/ Belfast News-Letter, 4 January 1856, p.1].</ref> His name, district, age and retired-merchant occupation in the 1883 death return make this a strong possible identification.<ref>[https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/deaths_returns/deaths_1883/06356/4823575.pdf Cookstown civil death return, 4 July 1883, printed p.300, entry 244].</ref>

In 1858 a senior William Glasgow testified as uncle of the plaintiffs Benjamin and William Glasgow in a Cookstown mill dispute.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/390574459/ Belfast News-Letter, 22 July 1858, p.3].</ref> The full viewer identifies Benjamin as son of the late Robert Glasgow; counsel’s reference to Robert’s sons supports a qualified brother inference for co-plaintiff William. The uncle’s side of the family is unstated. This retired merchant remains a strong compatible candidate for the senior witness, but no inspected will or deed yet joins him to the nephews.
